before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the CSV and aggregate revenue by region
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
totals = df.groupby('region', as_index=True)['revenue'].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
ax.bar(totals.index, totals.values)
ax.set_title('地域ごとの総売上')
ax.set_xlabel('地域')
ax.set_ylabel('総売上')
ax.set_ylim(0, totals.max() * 1.15)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
